name: Gulf Shores Surf & Racquet Club
description:
Can’t decide between the Gulf or the Bay? Indulge in the best of both worlds at Gulf Shores Surf & Racquet Club, where a picturesque location directly on Little Lagoon is complemented by beach access right across the street. Spend your days kayaking and boating in Little Lagoon, playing tennis and pickleball on the edge of the water, lounging by the pool, and exploring Gulf Shores from your private condo.
